en.headline: Checkpoints expected to handle 7.44 million trips over Golden Week
en.dek: Immigration Department forecasts peak outbound land traffic on 3 October and peak inbound on 4 October, with Lo Wu, Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and Shenzhen Bay busiest.
body: The Immigration Department estimated that about 7.44 million passenger trips by Hong Kong residents and visitors will pass through the city’s sea, land and air control points between 1 and 7 October during the Mainland National Day Golden Week.

Of these, roughly 6.31 million trips are expected via land boundary control points. Outbound land traffic is forecast to peak on Saturday 3 October at about 587,000 trips, while inbound traffic is expected to peak on Sunday 4 October at about 586,000 trips.

Lo Wu, Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and Shenzhen Bay control points are anticipated to be the busiest, with daily averages of about 220,000, 190,000 and 150,000 trips respectively. The department said no extension of operating hours is planned.

Additional inspection counters, temporary counters and vehicle examination kiosks will be opened in advance. Front-line leave has been reduced to allow flexible deployment, and extra security staff will assist with crowd control. A joint command centre will operate at Lo Wu involving Immigration, Police, Customs and the MTR Corporation, with close liaison maintained with Mainland counterparts.

zh.headline: 國慶黃金周料744萬人次進出香港
zh.dek: 入境處預計陸路出境高峰為10月3日、入境高峰為10月4日，羅湖、落馬洲支線及深圳灣最繁忙。
body: 入境事務處預計，內地國慶黃金周期間（10月1日至7日），約有744萬人次包括香港居民及訪客經各海、陸、空管制站進出香港。
當中約631萬人次會經陸路邊境管制站進出。陸路出境高峰期為10月3日（星期六），約58.7萬人次；入境高峰期為10月4日（星期日），約58.6萬人次。
羅湖、落馬洲支線及深圳灣管制站預計最繁忙，每日平均分別約有22萬、19萬及15萬人次出入境。入境處表示不會延長各管制站服務時間。
入境處將預先加開更多檢查櫃枱、臨時櫃枱及車輛檢查亭，並減少前線人員休假以彈性調配人手，同時增派保安人員維持秩序。羅湖管制站將設立由入境處、警方、海關及港鐵組成的聯合指揮中心，並與內地部門緊密聯繫。
